answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 156239 Country: india Title: If we do not perform daily nafl salah of Zuhr, Maghrib and Isha, is this gunah? Question: If we do not perform daily nafl salah of Zuhr, Maghrib and Isha, is this gunah? Answer ID: 156239 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 175/114/SD=2/1439) There is no sin if one leaves nafl salah; but it carries rewards if offered. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
